best_rule: I2: long every today's-top-500 US stock with an officer/director open-market purchase (Form 4 code P, >= $10k), entry next close after filing date, hold 63 trading days, equal weight, short SPY 1:1, 10 bp per side

best.verdict: FAIL (3 of 6 gates: loses to the same-universe passive basket minus SPY, t < 2, event-shift placebo p 0.096; placebo books of the same stocks at random times already average Sharpe 0.37)

one_line: In today's 500 largest US stocks (2006-2026 SEC Form 4 data), insider purchases add at most a small timing edge over the same stocks at random dates (best p 0.10, never at the 0.05 level) and no tradable edge: the SPY-hedged books mostly carry survivorship drift (the passive same-universe basket minus SPY has post-2014 Sharpe 1.0), hedging that drift out leaves negative Sharpe, and clusters, opportunistic insiders (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski), $100k+ buys, top executives and 5-day holds all do worse.
